History:
Lark Shasha is a female warrior of an advanced demon tribe of Oni. The demons range from the lowly goblins and Ogre to the more advanced Rakshasa. Lark Shasha is a fearsome demon of the mythical class known as Rakshasa. She was defeated by Edwin Black in a power struggle in the Dark World and lost most of her power. To regain her power, she travels to the human world to track down the Immortal King.

Lark works as a mercenary and changes, who she works for based on who gives more money at first.
[From [url=https://breezewiki.com/taimanin/wiki/Lark_Shasha]breezewiki.com[/url]]
